# Two Farm Cottages

> Luxury bed and breakfast in Amberley, West Sussex, in the South Downs National Park, run by Janet and Mike Wright. Two private guest rooms (one double, one twin) in an 1890s farm cottage, with a private guest bathroom and lounge. Bookings are for one family or group of friends at a time, up to four guests.

- Address: Two Farm Cottages, Rackham Road, Amberley, West Sussex, BN18 9NT
- Telephone: +44 (0)1798 831266 / 07379 100061
- Email: mikewright45@icloud.com
- Check-in from 4.00 pm; check-out by 10.30 am
- Payment by BACS, cheque or cash

## Rooms
- [Double Bedroom](https://www.twofarmcottages.co.uk/double-bedroom/): south-facing, views of the South Downs
- [Twin Bedroom](https://www.twofarmcottages.co.uk/twin-bedroom/): north-facing, views over the Amberley Wildbrooks

## Booking
- [Tariff](https://www.twofarmcottages.co.uk/tariff/): prices per person per night, children's rates, 10% off stays of 3+ nights
- [Contact & Booking](https://www.twofarmcottages.co.uk/contact/)

## Food
- [Sample Breakfast Menu](https://www.twofarmcottages.co.uk/sample-menu/): breakfast nominated for an AA excellence award
